title: Indexing and Optimization
description: PostgreSQL index types, scan methods, join strategies, planner statistics and how to read EXPLAIN to speed up queries.

root.label: Indexing & Optimization
root.detail: Help the planner pick a cheap plan.

children.label: Index types
children.detail: Choose by operator.

children.label: B-tree
children.detail: Default; =, <, >, BETWEEN, ORDER BY, LIKE 'abc%' (C collation).

children.label: Hash
children.detail: Equality only; WAL-logged since PG10.

children.label: GIN
children.detail: Multi-value: JSONB, arrays, full text, pg_trgm.

children.label: GiST / BRIN
children.detail: GiST: geometric/range; BRIN: huge naturally ordered tables.

children.label: Index design
children.detail: Shape indexes to queries.

children.label: Multicolumn order
children.detail: Leftmost columns usable alone; equality first.

children.label: Partial index
children.detail: CREATE INDEX ... WHERE shipped_date IS NULL.

children.label: Expression index
children.detail: ON lower(email); query must match expression.

children.label: Covering (INCLUDE)
children.detail: Enables index-only scans.

children.label: Index foreign keys
children.detail: Postgres does not auto-index FK columns.

children.label: Write cost
children.detail: Each index slows INSERT/UPDATE and blocks HOT updates.

children.label: Scan methods
children.detail: How rows are read.

children.label: Seq Scan
children.detail: Reads whole table; best for large fractions.

children.label: Index Scan
children.detail: Few rows; random heap access.

children.label: Index Only Scan
children.detail: No heap visit if visibility map is set.

children.label: Bitmap Heap Scan
children.detail: Middle ground; combines indexes with AND/OR.

children.label: Join strategies
children.detail: Physical join algorithms.

children.label: Nested Loop
children.detail: Small outer + indexed inner; only option for some non-equi joins.

children.label: Hash Join
children.detail: Build hash on smaller input; equi-joins, no order needed.

children.label: Merge Join
children.detail: Both inputs sorted on key; good for large sorted sets.

children.label: Statistics
children.detail: Planner estimates from pg_statistic.

children.label: ANALYZE
children.detail: Samples tables; autovacuum runs it.

children.label: Statistics target
children.detail: ALTER COLUMN SET STATISTICS for skewed columns.

children.label: Extended statistics
children.detail: CREATE STATISTICS for correlated columns.

children.label: Reading EXPLAIN
children.detail: Plan tree, costs, rows.

children.label: Estimated vs actual
children.detail: Big row mismatch means bad stats.

children.label: BUFFERS
children.detail: Shared hit vs read shows I/O.

children.label: Query rewrites
children.detail: Sargable, set-based SQL.

children.label: Sargable predicates
children.detail: No function on indexed column; use ranges for dates.

children.label: EXISTS over IN/DISTINCT
children.detail: Semi-join stops at first match.

children.label: Aggregate early
children.detail: Shrink rows before joining.

children.label: Keyset pagination
children.detail: WHERE id > last LIMIT n beats large OFFSET.
